data.name: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler
data.detailed_description:
Build. Optimize. Relax.

Welcome to the Jaden Industries, Engineer - a calm Archipelago of floating islands awaiting exploration.
As an Engineer on an airship expedition, your task is to set up production across the skies by designing elegant systems of extraction, transport, and refinement. And even, maybe, you can try to uncover the mysteries at the heart of the Archipelago.

A Tiny Factory-Builder Experience
Each island is a self-contained engineering puzzle where precision and creativity shape the outcome.
Connect conveyors, mixers, and processing machines to transform elemental resources into complex alchemical products - from raw dust to bottled elixirs or astral fabric. Stay within budget to earn higher rewards. Research technologies to unlock new machines and increase efficiency for new islands or revisit earlier islands to refine your designs.

Beginner-Friendly & Stress-Free
There’s no rush or pressure - just the meditative rhythm of automation and the quiet satisfaction of making everything work in perfect harmony.
Jaden Industries invites you to think, experiment, and find beauty in balance.

Key Features

  • Compact Factory Puzzles - Solve focused automation challenges with multiple solutions.

  • Progressive Complexity - Unlock new machines, ingredients, and technologies as you expand the Archipelago.

  • Optimization & Budget System: Stay within budget to earn meta-currency and rewards, with freedom to improve solutions later.

  • Persistent Progress - Revisit islands to improve efficiency and expand your designs.

  • Non-Linear Exploration: Choose your path through the Archipelago and revisit earlier islands with new tech.

  • Map Editor & Steam Workshop: Create and share custom levels with the community.

Whether you're a seasoned factory builder or new to the genre, this compact, satisfying experience offers plenty of depth in a soothing package.
